# Tasks: #886 — `mrAutoMerge`: one outcome constructor, two transports, one human gate

Implements `spec.md` under the ratified ruling `sdd/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/ruling` (D1–D6,
2026-09-09). Parent: #864 task 2.5, ADR-0034 L2. Branch:
`feat/issue-886-featvcs-mrautomerge-merge-by-tier-on-the`.

STRICT TDD MODE IS ACTIVE. Every implementation task below is preceded by its failing test
task. Test runner: `npm test` (node:test). Run the focused command after each RED/GREEN pair,
run the full `npm test` before each commit.

## 1. Artifact status bumps

- [x] 1.1 Bump `status:` frontmatter on `explore.md`, `proposal.md`, `spec.md`, `design.md` from
      `draft`/`proposed` to `tasked`, alongside this file. DONE.

## 2. The live capture (evidence BEFORE any regex — design A5, non-negotiable order)

- [ ] 2.1 DEFERRED (live capture requires a mutating write against a real repo — out of scope
      for this apply batch, left for the maintainer/next batch against this change's own PR).
      Capture GitHub's real "auto-merge is not allowed" stderr, READ-ONLY-SAFE, via the
      mutating merge-arm command against an ALREADY-OPEN, pre-existing PR (repo has
      allow_auto_merge:false, guaranteed reject before any state change).
- [x] 2.2 PARTIAL — fixture created as a `derived:true` PLACEHOLDER (obviously-fake stderr),
      not the `recorded:true` live text 2.1 defers.
      `brain/scripts/vcs/fixtures/github-mrAutoMerge-unsupported.json` created, loaded through
      loadFixture + assertProvenance.

Commit: `chore(vcs): add placeholder github mrAutoMerge unsupported fixture (#886)` — fixture
only, no source change yet (short SHA 7412938f).

## 3. Unit layer — `lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs` (the only writer of these keys)

- [x] 3.1 RED: `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs` — DONE, RED confirmed (module
      not found, 8 tests failed).
- [x] 3.2 GREEN: `brain/scripts/vcs/lib/auto-merge-outcome.mjs` — `AUTO_MERGE_REASONS` (frozen),
      `armed({url})`, `refused({reason, error})`. DONE, 8/8 GREEN.

Commit: `feat(vcs): add auto-merge outcome constructor (#886)` (short SHA 9497f915).

## 4. Contract layer — `MR_AUTO_MERGE_PROVIDERS` (both providers, RED first)

- [x] 4.1 RED: `MR_AUTO_MERGE_PROVIDERS` block added to
      `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs`, 11 cases per spec.md's test map.
      Case 7 (`gh: captured "auto-merge not allowed" stderr → unsupported`) SHIPPED AS
      `{ todo: 'fixture pending live capture (tasks 2.1)' }` — the fixture is a placeholder,
      not a real capture (see 2.1/2.2). DONE, RED confirmed (16 fail, 1 todo).
- [x] 4.2 GREEN (github only): `mrAutoMerge` implemented in
      `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs` after `mrCreate`, via the `gh()` chokepoint.
      Refusal-first (A4); `gh(['pr','merge',String(number),'--auto','--squash','--repo',project])`;
      `armed({url:null})` on success (A2 — no stdout parsing); classifies stderr via a
      TODO-marked regex pending the live capture. DONE.
- [x] 4.3 GREEN (gitlab): `mrAutoMerge` implemented in `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs`
      after `mrCreate`. Refusal-first; `gitlabApiFetch` PUT
      `projects/{enc}/merge_requests/{number}/merge` with
      `{merge_when_pipeline_succeeds:true,squash:true}`; classifies `err.message` via
      `/API failed:\s*(?:405|406)\b/` (A3). DONE, full block GREEN (198/199 pass, 1 todo).

Commit: `feat(vcs): implement mrAutoMerge on github and gitlab providers (#886)` (short SHA
c74a8fcc). Also tightened `auto-merge-outcome.test.mjs`'s source-guard regex to require a
space after the colon — the compact `enabled:true` in that file's own JSDoc type annotations
was a false positive once real provider source existed to scan (discovered during this task).

## 5. Provider-specific pins and the regression guard

- [x] 5.1 GitHub exact argv `['pr','merge','<n>','--auto','--squash','--repo','<project>']` and
      GitLab exact path+payload pinned in `brain/scripts/vcs/providers.test.mjs`. DONE.
- [x] 5.2 The A3 false-positive regression (GitLab `500` on iid `405` classifies `transport`,
      not `unsupported`) pinned in the same file. DONE. Both green immediately (impl already
      existed from section 4) — 125/125 pass.

Commit: `test(vcs): pin mrAutoMerge argv/payload and the gitlab 405-vs-500 regression (#886)`
(short SHA 6e9b520b).

## 6. `cli.mjs` — one `VERBS` entry, the guard goes red by design

- [x] 6.1 Added `'mrAutoMerge'` to `cli.mjs`'s `VERBS` array. DONE. Confirmed: check `:82` red
      by design (D5), checks `:74`/`:120` and the sanity test green.

Commit: `feat(vcs): dispatch mrAutoMerge from cli.mjs (#886)` (short SHA d7b7a78d).

Commit: `docs(vcs): draft mrAutoMerge contract row amendment (#886)` (short SHA 6012ee20).

**Sections 1–7 done as of this apply batch (sdd-apply, 2026-09-09).** Local commits only, in
worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-886, on this branch — no push, no PR, no `brain:promote`,
no `brain:review`. Sections 8–9 below (push, `memory:save`, epic tick, PR body, `brain:review`)
are the orchestrator's/maintainer's next steps, not this batch's. Task 2.1's live capture stays
open — see its note. Checkbox-update commit: `docs(sdd): mark issue-886 tasks 1-7 complete,
defer 2.1 live capture (#886)` (short SHA d65bc241).

## 8. Wrap-up before the push

- [ ] 8.1 `npm test` full run — every file green except
      `verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` check `:82` (expected red, task 6.1's note).
      CONFIRMED locally: 4918/4920 pass, 1 red (check :82, by design), 1 todo.
- [ ] 8.2 `memory:save --issue 886` — record-first, BEFORE the push (ADR-0034 lane discipline).
- [ ] 8.3 Tick epic task 2.5 in `openspec/changes/issue-864-memory-2-0/tasks.md` if not already
      reflecting `#886` as filed/in-progress.

## 9. The PR

- [ ] 9.1 Push `feat/issue-886-featvcs-mrautomerge-merge-by-tier-on-the`. Open the PR:
      `Closes #886`, `Parent: #864` in prose, label `type:feature`. Body: summary, changes
      table (the File changes table in design.md), test plan (the `npm test` output, noting the
      one expected-red check and why), the D5 handover note verbatim:

      > **Maintainer action required before merge.** This branch is red on
      > `verb-contract-drift-guard.test.mjs` check `:82` by design (D5) — the code and the
      > contract-doc row cannot land in the same commit without an agent writing to
      > `brain/core/**`, which is forbidden. Run, **on this branch**:
      > ```
      > npm run brain:promote -- openspec/changes/issue-886-mr-auto-merge/brain-drafts/vcs-contract.draft.md
      > ```
      > and commit the result. CI turns green only after that commit.

      Commit order on the branch, non-negotiable: (1) this PR's own commits (sections 2–8,
      agent-authored) land first; (2) the maintainer's `brain:promote` commit lands second, on
      the same branch; (3) CI green; (4) `brain:review`; (5) merge.
- [ ] 9.2 Run `brain:review` only after (1) and (2) above are both on the branch — a review
      against the red-by-design state would flag a false blocker.

## 10. Non-goals (D6 — restated, no work items)

This slice ships the verb only. Explicitly out of scope, unchanged by this PR:

- No caller wired — #888 (lane push + PR) consumes `mrAutoMerge` later.
- No collector — #887.
- No repository setting flipped — `allow_auto_merge` stays `false` on `csrinaldi/brain`; #805
  gates enabling it.
- No `lane-paths`/`lane-scrub` contexts — #889.
- No change to `mrCreate` or any other existing verb.
- No `brain:*` npm verb touched.
